Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.
The focus_unit_id identifies the clause to classify. Other supplied units are context for resolving its references, not additional effects to merge into that focus. Interpret the acquired operation for that focus clause, using its actual context.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "The receiving party may retain a copy solely for the source-stated archival purpose after or notwithstanding disposal.", "name": "archival_copy_permission"}, {"meaning": "The unit expressly prohibits retaining the protected information, copies, notes, or abstracts after the relevant disposal process.", "name": "explicit_post_disposal_retention_prohibition"}, {"meaning": "The unit states no explicit post-disposal retention permission or prohibition.", "name": "no_retention_effect_in_this_unit"}, {"meaning": "The unit has an explicit post-disposal retention effect not faithfully represented by the available distinctions and must remain unresolved.", "name": "other_explicit_retention_effect"}], "examples": [{"choice": "archival_copy_permission", "quote": "Recipient shall, upon termination of this Agreement, or upon written request of Discloser, whichever is earlier, immediately, but not later than 10 days after any notice thereof by Discloser, return (or destroy at Discloser’s option) all copies of such Discloser’s Confidential Information and certify in writing its compliance with this requirement, except that Recipient may retain a copy of such Confidential Information solely for archival purpose.", "source": "ContractNLI:4d4e550ac17660215ea791c0b3a37cbef136c2e7642e6cbeb3cc9a3df43eeb40"}, {"choice": "explicit_post_disposal_retention_prohibition", "quote": "Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.", "source": "ContractNLI:354623271a5433b9d6fe42ec70538acd25e9f7e37aee568c81e2e7d4912f9450"}], "name": "retention_clause", "question": "Classify the final unit's explicit retention effect following or notwithstanding the relevant return or destruction process. Do not infer retention from silence, classify an ordinary ongoing no-copy rule as post-disposal retention, or confuse survival of confidentiality with retention."}], "current_queries": [{"id": "retention:30", "operation": "retention_clause", "unit_ids": [27, 28, 29, 30], "current_units": [{"id": 27, "text": " Volunteer agrees to maintain the confidentiality of all Confidential Information and not misuse, misappropriate, or disclose in writing, orally or by electronic means, any Confidential Information, directly or indirectly, to any other person or use them in any way, either during the term of this Agreement or at any other time thereafter, except as is required in the course of service to the CCPDT."}, {"id": 28, "text": " Volunteer acknowledges and agrees that all Confidential Information and similar items whether maintained in hard copy, electronically or on-line relating to CCPDT’s business shall remain exclusively the property of the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers and shall only be used by Volunteer for the purpose(s) permitted by the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers."}, {"id": 29, "text": " Volunteer further agrees that upon termination of service with CCPDT, Volunteer shall return within ten (10) business days all documents, files, electronic or otherwise, and property comprising Confidential Information of CCPDT and all copies, electronic or otherwise, thereof relating in any way to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ business, or in any way obtained during the course of service."}, {"id": 30, "text": "Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed."}], "focus_unit_id": 30}]}
